content.user_title: Manage Google Keep Notes from AI Assistants
content.value_statement: Google Keep work can be hard to inspect from an AI assistant. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code manage notes through the Google Workspace CLI.
actual_capabilities: Lists Google Keep notes with pagination guidance.
Gets individual notes through the Keep notes resource.
Creates and deletes notes when the caller has permission.
Describes permissions operations for Keep note sharing.
Uses gws schema output to inspect required parameters.
limitations: Requires the gws CLI and configured Google authentication.
Only exposes the Keep resources documented in SKILL.md.
Delete actions are immediate and cannot be undone.
Attachment downloads depend on available MIME types and REST media support.

use_cases.title: Find Team Notes
use_cases.description: List recent Keep notes, open the right note, and verify task details.

use_cases.title: Create Quick Notes
use_cases.description: Create a Keep note from meeting decisions without leaving the assistant.

use_cases.title: Review Shared Access
use_cases.description: Inspect note permissions before changing collaborators or deleting obsolete notes.

prompt_templates.title: List Recent Notes
prompt_templates.prompt: List my Google Keep notes using gws keep. Show titles and updated times.

prompt_templates.title: Open a Note
prompt_templates.prompt: Get the Keep note named [title]. Summarize its checklist items and attachments.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Structured Note
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Keep note called [title] with these points: [points]. Use the schema before sending parameters.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Shared Notes
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect Keep notes matching [topic], review permissions, and identify notes that may need access changes.

output_examples.input: List my recent Keep notes about project planning.
output_examples.output: A concise note list with titles, update times, and any next page token guidance.

output_examples.input: Create a note for the decisions from today's meeting.
output_examples.output: A confirmation with the new note title and the key points that were saved.

output_examples.input: Check who can access the shared onboarding note.
output_examples.output: A permission summary showing current collaborators and roles, with suggested review points.

best_practices: Inspect each method with gws schema before passing parameters.
Confirm note deletion with the user before calling delete.
Limit requests to notes the user owns or is authorized to access.
anti_patterns: Do not delete notes based only on a partial title match.
Do not paste large private notes into unrelated prompts.
Do not bypass Google authentication or permission checks.

faq.question: Does this skill require Google authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. The gws CLI must be installed and authenticated for the target Google account.

faq.question: Can it delete notes?
faq.answer: Yes. Delete is available for notes where the caller has the OWNER role. Confirm first because deletion is immediate.

faq.question: Can it download attachments?
faq.answer: Yes, when attachment media is available in the requested MIME type and the REST media request is supported.

faq.question: Does it manage labels?
faq.answer: No. The documented resources are media, notes, and permissions.

faq.question: Can it work without the gws CLI?
faq.answer: No. The skill describes commands for the gws Google Workspace CLI.

faq.question: Is it safe for shared notes?
faq.answer: Use caution. Review permissions before changing or deleting shared notes.
